text:
caroline: Heads up 1: we got reports that 'touchpoint-check' playbook bumped healthscore for ~60 customers twice this morning. Looks like CRM dedupe window shortened last week and duplicate contact merges surfaced duplicate events.

bryce: I pulled runner logs 1: duplicate trigger payloads with same crm_contact_id but different crm_event_uuid. The playbook uses webhook.event_hash for idempotency; the connector change removed event_hash when merge happened.

zhen: Quick containment: can we pause outbound actions for any account with >1 playbook_runs in last 2 hours? I'll create a scheduler guard to skip if recent_run_count > 1.

ops-bot: Incident created: CS-2026-116 1: playbook-healthscore-duplication (severity: medium).

caroline: Also need a one-off healthscore rollback or recompute for affected accounts so renewal signals aren't inflated. Prefer recompute to rollback.

bryce: Plan: 1) apply scheduler guard (zhen) 2) push connector tweak to restore event_hash on merge events (bryce) 3) run healthscore backfill for affected accounts (zhen) 4) notify CSMs with the list (caroline).

zhen: Pushed scheduler guard to staging, will flip in 5m. Also writing a backfill script to recalc last_event_window and healthscore delta.

caroline: I'll draft the CSM note: short, admit noise, actions taken, and ETA for backfill.

bryce: Connector patch merged; we now set payload.event_hash = md5(contact_id || origin_event_uuid) during merge. Deployed to prod.

zhen: Backfill kicked off, ETA ~45m for 60 accounts. Will post summary of corrected healthscore deltas.

caroline: Thanks all. Add postmortem item: update playbook runbook to include connector merge behavior, add metric for 'playbook dedupe rate' in console, and add test to confirm event_hash survives contact merges. Closing after backfill and CSM notifications. :white_check_mark:
